subject: She has nowhere to be. Except, perhaps, your sofa.
preheader: Meet Mabel, twelve years young and ready for a quieter chapter.

attrs.alt: A relaxed older cream-and-ginger cat rests her front paws on a sunlit windowsill and looks calmly toward the camera.

content.text: Mabel is twelve. She greets the morning light, finds the warm patch in the room and settles in as if she has been there forever.
She is looking for a quieter chapter: kind voices, familiar company and a home with room for an older cat’s rhythm.
If that sounds like your kind of life, we would love to introduce you.
We will talk through the right match together.

MABEL / 12 YEARS YOUNG

She has
nowhere
to be.

 

Except, perhaps, your sofa.

Dear friend,

 

Mabel is twelve. She greets the morning light, finds the warm patch in the room and settles in as if she has been there forever.

 

She is looking for a quieter chapter: kind voices, familiar company and a home with room for an older cat’s rhythm.

 

If that sounds like your kind of life, we would love to introduce you.

 

FAVOURITE PLACE

 

The sunny patch
by the window.

 
 

IDEAL HOME

 

A quiet room.
A little company.

 
Meet Mabel
 

A friendly introduction.
We will talk through the right match together.

 

With love,

 

WINDOWSEAT

Older cats. New chapters.
